_comment: Configurable heuristic used by src/ai_exposure.py. This is an ANALYTICAL INDICATOR, not a validated prediction of job displacement. Edit freely to reflect your own judgement or newer research.

ai_substitutable.label: AI-Substitutable
ai_substitutable.explanation: Tasks that current generative-AI / automation tools can already perform end-to-end with limited human review.

ai_augmented.label: AI-Augmented
ai_augmented.explanation: Tasks where AI tools significantly speed up the work, but a human is still needed to direct, verify, and integrate the output.

ai_complementary.label: AI-Complementary
ai_complementary.explanation: Tasks that rely on judgement, novel problem framing, human relationships, physical presence, or accountability that AI cannot presently substitute for.
